## Three hypotheses, stress-tested

The common thread is methodological: isolate a claim, test it under a fixed
compute budget, and keep the negative result when the evidence does not
support the original story.
:::

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-card__topline}
<span class="project-number">01</span>
<span class="status-chip">Manuscript</span>
:::

### Few-Step Field Regularity

::: {.project-question}
Can averaged field regularity rank probability paths when a flow ODE is solved
with only a few function evaluations?
:::

::: {.project-finding}
**Finding**

An exact one-dimensional Gaussian construction reverses the regularity and
Heun error orderings at eight function evaluations.
:::

::: {.project-links}
[Repository](https://github.com/clement-callaert/fewstep-field-regularity)
[Manuscript](https://github.com/clement-callaert/fewstep-field-regularity/blob/main/paper/arxiv/main.pdf)
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-card__topline}
<span class="project-number">02</span>
<span class="status-chip status-chip--negative">Negative result</span>
:::

### Ego-World JEPA

::: {.project-question}
Does a factored latent world model make model-predictive control more effective
on PushT?
:::

::: {.project-finding}
**Finding**

Strong in-slice decodability did not produce a robust planning benefit; the
apparent seed-0 gap disappeared on the second seed.
:::

::: {.project-links}
[Repository & results](https://github.com/clement-callaert/ego-world-sub-jepa)
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-card__topline}
<span class="project-number">03</span>
<span class="status-chip status-chip--exploration">Exploration</span>
:::

### Adaptive Latent Search

::: {.project-question}
Can a learned stop-or-continue controller allocate latent-search compute better
than fixed budgets and simple diagnostics?
:::

::: {.project-finding}
**Finding**

In a small `pattern_2d` sandbox, the learned controller did not beat a
gradient-norm stopping rule despite a substantial oracle gap.
:::

::: {.project-links}
[Research branch](https://github.com/clement-callaert/lpn/tree/research/stochastic-latent-search)
[Report](https://github.com/clement-callaert/lpn/blob/research/stochastic-latent-search/report/main.pdf)
:::
:::

Research practice

## Evidence before narrative

I want each public artifact to stay useful even when its original hypothesis
does not hold.
:::

::: {.method-grid}
::: {.method-step}
<span>01</span>

**Specify**

Turn an appealing hypothesis into a falsifiable protocol.
:::

::: {.method-step}
<span>02</span>

**Compare**

Use strong baselines and equal, explicit compute budgets.
:::

::: {.method-step}
<span>03</span>

**Diagnose**

Inspect numerical behavior, seed sensitivity, and failure modes.
:::

::: {.method-step}
<span>04</span>

**Bound**

State exactly where the conclusion stops generalizing.
:::
:::

## Engineering, mathematics, and research
:::

::: {.home-about__copy}
I am completing the Engineering Degree at CentraleSupélec, specializing in
Mathematics and Data Science, alongside the Research Master's in Mathematics
and Artificial Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay. I also work as a
Generative AI Engineer at MBDA on multi-agent systems built around large
language models, following a Data Scientist apprenticeship at TotalEnergies'
Digital Factory.
